authoredBeats.label: Set
authoredBeats.cue: Shoulder blades set; feet stay planted.

authoredBeats.label: Lower
authoredBeats.cue: Bend elbows; keep wrists over elbows.

authoredBeats.label: Chest touch
authoredBeats.cue: Touch lightly; keep the neck clear.

authoredBeats.label: Drive
authoredBeats.cue: Press upward and back toward shoulders.

authoredBeats.label: Lockout
authoredBeats.cue: Straight arms; hips remain on bench.

setup: Lie on the bench with both feet planted and shoulder blades set.
Grip the bar just outside shoulders and unrack before the shown cycle.

authoredBeats.label: Set your stretch
authoredBeats.cue: Stand tall; lower heels below the step.

authoredBeats.label: Raise your heels
authoredBeats.cue: Push through forefeet; keep knees softly straight.

authoredBeats.label: Squeeze your calves
authoredBeats.cue: Lift heels high and squeeze your calves.

authoredBeats.label: Hold the top
authoredBeats.cue: Pause briefly; keep your torso upright.

authoredBeats.label: Lower slowly
authoredBeats.cue: Lower your heels slowly without bouncing.

authoredBeats.label: Return to stretch
authoredBeats.cue: Let heels sink below the step gently.
